messages:
maya: hi all, day 2 here. i'm preparing a live demo for tomorrow and my local streaming test keeps getting 429s after ~6s. should i switch to the hosted org key for the demo or is there a sandbox/dev workflow i should follow? also i can't find any "Sandbox" key in Console, only an "Org API Key".

noah: welcome! :tada: short answer: for iterative dev use the sandbox key. hosted keys are for staging/prod and often sit behind IP allowlists. for a one-off demo we can either provision a temporary sandbox quota bump or issue an ephemeral token tied to the demo window.

maya: perfect. how do i request the temporary bump? and is it safe to use the hosted key if i add my laptop IP to a whitelist?

tiago_infra: please don't use a hosted key on your laptop unless infra explicitly whitelists your IP and you understand billing implications. steps: 1) Console -> API Keys -> Org dropdown -> check "Dev / Sandbox" (if absent provisioning needed). 2) Open the compute quota/provision form: https://intranet.redwood/company-forms/compute-quota and select "Temporary dev bump" and put demo date/time. 3) paste the exact 429 response in the form (rate_bucket + retry_after helps us pick the right pool).

maya: here's the 429 body I caught: {"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","rate_bucket":"sb_stream_demo_small","retry_after":4} — is that enough?

tiago_infra: yes that's perfect. include your sample requests-per-minute and whether you're using WebSocket or SSE. we can grant a scoped bump for N hours. if you need steady throughput consider recording and replaying the stream locally for iterations, then use the temporary bump only for the live demo.

ben_devex: small checklist: 1) never commit keys; put a .env in .gitignore and include .env.sample in repo. 2) prefer ephemeral tokens for demos (Console -> Create ephemeral token). 3) implement exponential backoff honoring Retry-After to avoid burning the quota. 4) if you must use hosted keys for an internal demo, request IP whitelist via the secure-networking form: https://intranet.redwood/company-forms/network-whitelist.

provisioning-bot: Quick links: Dev keys guide - https://intranet.redwood/docs/dev-keys • Streaming best practices - https://intranet.redwood/docs/streaming-guide • Quota/provision form - https://intranet.redwood/company-forms/compute-quota. When filing include full response JSON and rate_bucket id.

maya: awesome, thanks everyone. i'll file the quota form with the 429 JSON and request a 3-hour demo bump for tomorrow 10:00-13:00, and i'll use an ephemeral token instead of the long-lived hosted key. will ping here if infra needs anything else :thumbsup:
